all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
Psalm 64:10
Quote of the Day
"Covenant faithfulness does more than identify us as God’s people—it empowers us to rise above the limitations of this fallen world."
Elder Alan R. Walker | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
